entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: A 5G NAS message used by the UE to respond to an identity request from the network.

entities.name: Extended protocol discriminator
entities.description: Identifies the protocol type for 5G NAS messages.

entities.name: Security header type
entities.description: Indicates the security protection applied to the NAS message.

entities.name: Spare half octet
entities.description: Reserved bits for alignment in the NAS message header.

entities.name: Identity response message identity
entities.description: Identifies the message type as IDENTITY RESPONSE.

entities.name: Mobile identity
entities.description: Contains the UE's 5GS mobile identity (e.g., SUCI, 5G-GUTI) in response to an identity request.

relations.description: IDENTITY RESPONSE message includes the Extended protocol discriminator IE.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message includes the Security header type IE.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message includes the Spare half octet IE.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message includes the Message identity IE.
IDENTITY RESPONSE message includes the Mobile identity IE containing the UE's 5GS identity.
